articles.title: Unmasking 44 Nysa: The First Triple-Lobed Asteroid—With a Moon!
articles.summary: Astronomers have revealed that asteroid 44 Nysa is the first known triple-lobed body, with a tiny moon in tow. High-contrast imaging unmasked its bizarre shape after 169 years of mystery.

articles.title: An Orphan Black Hole Shreds a Star: NASA's Swift Sees a Cosmic Exile
articles.summary: A supermassive black hole, 30,000 light-years from its galaxy's core, tore apart a star in a flare 10 billion times brighter than the sun. This rare tidal disruption event validates a new way to find wandering black holes.

articles.title: Signed, Sealed, Delivered: Roman Sling Bullets Taunt Rebels with a General's Name
articles.summary: In Catalonia, archaeologists unearthed lead sling bullets inscribed with "CN D"—the mark of Roman general Gnaeus Domitius Calvinus. The 2,100-year-old ammunition pinpoints the final battle of the Ceretani Revolt.
